description: Post a public reply to a comment on the brand’s Facebook or Instagram post. This is PUBLIC and posted as the brand — show the user the exact wording and get their go-ahead first. With private:true it instead sends ONE private message to the commenter (Messenger / Instagram Direct) — once per comment, within 7 days.

account.description: which Instagram account — an @handle or id from list_connector_accounts("instagram"). Needed when several are linked, and the way an Instagram Login (standalone) account is reached; omit for the one Page-linked account.

pageId.description: Page id — omit when only one Page is connected

private.description: true = send ONE PRIVATE message to the person who left the comment (Messenger / Instagram Direct) instead of a public reply — the way to answer "price?" or "DM me". Meta allows one per comment, within 7 days of it.

name: reply_to_meta_comment
title: Reply to a Facebook/Instagram comment
